campaign: C7 -- E2 analytic lower-bound strengthening for Lambda_309

target.quantity: Lambda_309 = E_a[tau] for the frozen CUSUM model, m = 5, cell 309

compute_boundary.arithmetic: python3 stdlib fractions.Fraction only, outward rounding on a 2^-320 grid
compute_boundary.enforcement: asserted by code/c7_b0_audit.py via an ast import walk, not merely declared

prospective_choices.e_evaluated: 19839101/10000000 (the cell's lower endpoint e_lo; ANY point in the closed cell is valid, and e_lo is optimal because E[V] increases in e and the bound decreases in E[V])
prospective_choices.N_partition_rationale: a uniform partition u_j = j*H/64. Fixed for reviewer reproducibility: it re-runs in ~17s against ~75s at N=256, and the convergence sweep shows 4x refinement is worth under 0.1%, which alters no verdict.
prospective_choices.a_grid_for_lemma_C7_U: {j/4 : j = 8..24}, a uniform untuned grid on [2, 6]
prospective_choices.u0_ladder_for_tier2: {j*H/8 : j = 1..8}, a uniform untuned grid (tier 2 is superseded by tier k and is retained only as a cross-check)

U_sources_admitted.origin: certified admissible A0 at cell 309, via Lemma SM(d)

dependencies: Lorden (1970), cited but NOT re-proved in C7

selection_rule.combination: Lambda_309 >= max over all valid bounds, per the campaign instruction. Every bound in the family is individually valid, so the max is valid.
selection_rule.PRIMARY_bound: the largest bound whose dependency set is EMPTY. C7's purpose is to restore robustness to an exclusion whose margin was questioned, so a bound that inherits the disputed Arb surface cannot be the headline.
selection_rule.reporting: all four bounds are reported with their dependency sets, so an adjudicator may discount any surface and read off what survives.

rule.STRENGTHENED: the PRIMARY bound strictly exceeds C4's certified floor AND its margin over the C5-T critical A0 strictly exceeds C4's margin over the same critical A0
rule.MARGINAL: the PRIMARY bound strictly exceeds C4's floor but a dependency-free bound does not, i.e. the improvement exists only on a disputed surface
rule.NO_IMPROVEMENT: no bound strictly exceeds C4's floor

verdict.no_tuned_threshold: The verdict rule contains NO tuned numeric threshold. It compares C7's output against C4's own published numbers only. ROBUST_5 and ROBUST_10 in the ledger are DESCRIPTIVE reporting bands, not verdict inputs, precisely so that no threshold can be accused of having been set to the answer.

kill_gates.KG1: any reported bound fails to strictly exceed C4's certified floor -> that route is NOT reported as an improvement
kill_gates.KG2: any monotonicity premise (r decreasing, f decreasing, p decreasing, psi_lo non-increasing along the partition) is violated at evaluation -> REFUSE
kill_gates.KG3: the LP weights fail to sum to exactly 1 in exact rational arithmetic -> REFUSE
kill_gates.KG4: the tier-k bound at k = 1 fails to reproduce the tier-1 bound exactly -> REFUSE
kill_gates.KG5: any LOWER bound produced exceeds a certified UPPER bound on the same quantity (the certified A0, or the E2-family analytic ceiling) -> REFUSE, since that is a contradiction and therefore an implementation error
kill_gates.KG6: the frozen CUSUM model file sha256 differs from efcc0f36632632577a24c4ddf1a7c2c3579d471cdba5a752dd72c708667cdc79 -> REFUSE
kill_gates.KG7: K + H != 11/2 -> REFUSE (C4's structural repair, inherited: mis-taking the threshold inflates the bound in the UNSOUND direction while leaving the verdict unchanged)
kill_gates.KG8: any mutant in the required-detection set survives -> REFUSE
kill_gates.KG9: any compute-boundary counter is non-zero -> REFUSE

permitted_conclusions: a strengthened certified LOWER bound on Lambda_309, with its dependency set stated
a restatement of the cell-309 exclusion margin under C5-T
an exhaustion statement about the analytic ceiling of the E2 family
forbidden_conclusions: that cell 309 is CLOSED (the exclusion is a statement about the deterministic route, not a closure)
that K5 is closed or that the m=5 tail is complete
that any other cell's status changes
that the R-stage may launch, or that EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED may become true
that the Arb/FLINT surface is validated or invalidated by C7

disclosure_of_non_blindness.statement: This gate was frozen AFTER exploratory evaluation of the theorem. At freeze time the campaign already knew approximate values for all four bounds. The gate does not claim blindness.
why_this_does_not_compromise_soundness: Every prospective choice -- the partition, the a-grid, the u0 ladder, the point e, the choice of U -- affects only the TIGHTNESS of a bound, never its VALIDITY. Each choice yields a valid certified lower bound; a different choice yields a different valid certified lower bound. There is no setting of any of them that can make an invalid result appear valid.
The verdict rule contains no tuned threshold, only strict comparisons against C4's published numbers, so there is no bar that could have been positioned to admit the answer.
The kill gates are all soundness checks, not performance bars; none of them can be satisfied by a better number.
disclosure_of_non_blindness.what_would_have_been_compromised_by_non_: a threshold-based verdict of the kind C1 and C2 used. C7 deliberately does not use one, for this reason.
disclosure_of_non_blindness.precedent: This programme has repeatedly recorded repairs as landed that had not, and has once shipped a reviewer's claim unverified. Disclosing the freeze order explicitly is cheaper than defending a blindness claim that the transcript would contradict.

invariants_C7_must_not_change: the frozen CUSUM model and its constants
any predecessor namespace (C4, C5, C6, K1 cover ledger)
the status of any cell other than the reported bound on 309
